name: Kusakabe Kyousuke
source:
“No, I'm just running an errand for my dad.
Ah, you're a second-year at Tsukuyomi, right?
We're the same age, so just call me Kyousuke.”

An employee at Café Etoile.

He was caught up in the mysterious Hitogawari incident that struck Advent City, where the habits and mindsets of many, especially young people, suddenly changed overnight, and as a result his personality and appearance were drastically altered.
